method: Copied verbatim from the primary's file on 2026-10-08, then edited by hand for the general ballot (issue #4): social narrowed to gender, LGBTQ+ and reproductive policy; parental-rights added; derived_from paths updated to the election-scoped layout. Rationale in rubric-derivation.md, section 'November 3, 2026 general: social split'. The measure descriptions and axis mappings rest on the Attorney General's explanatory statements for IL26-001, IL26-638 and IP26-645 (raw pointers listed; extracted text in the statewide package's interim/pdf-text/).
